description: Creating games with the FusionCR.com platform
summary: It is a game engine in which the player is tasked with avoiding enemies while collecting abandoned material from Mars itself and then escape on their ship. It's a multi-level game with a level generator built in through the editor, so it's nice and easy to add more levels and more trivia.
details:
We made a game engine in Clickteam FusionCR, plays as HTML5 content with arrow keys and one button, levels are generated dynamically and with ease thanks to our programming design, difficulty tuned from engine values, and every feature playtested. The idea is to use it as a building block for developing a web game in which you recover the hardware NASA left on Mars.

Kids hear about the missions still running. The machines that finished their work deserve a story too.

A message tells the story of the hardware left at this site. The player needs to collect every piece of equipment while enemies chase them over ladders, ledges and springs! Once recovered, they must flee and escape back to their ship to recover the next lot!

Mars Quest is an HTML5 game. It runs in any web browser with nothing to install, so it can live on a mission page, a classroom site or a museum screen.

Every piece you recover is a real piece of history.

Gameplay inspiration: classic single-screen arcade platformers, especially Hudson Soft's Nuts & Milk. Mars Quest's code, levels, setting and story are our own. No assets from other games are used.
